title.en: P99 5.9s Spike: The Gateway Metric That Pointed the Wrong Way
title.cn: P99 5.9 秒尖刺：网关指标指错了方向

symptom.en: External API gateway P99 on a large tenant's detection endpoint spiked to 5960ms; the gateway access log showed upstream_response_time=5.022s, which looked like a slow backend.
symptom.cn: 某大租户 detection 接口的外层 API gateway P99 冲到 5960ms，gateway access log 显示 upstream_response_time=5.022s，看上去像后端变慢。

localization.en: Drilled one layer down to the nginx ingress log: request_time=5.016s but true upstream_response_time was only 0.015s, so waiting_duration was 5.001s on a single ingress pod; the serving backend answered in 15ms with 0% errors throughout.
localization.cn: 下钻到 nginx ingress 层日志：request_time=5.016s 而真实 upstream_response_time 只有 0.015s，即单个 ingress pod 上 waiting_duration 达 5.001s；serving 后端全程 15ms 响应，错误率 0%。

fix.en: Ruled out memcached/Lua timeouts with a clean 90-minute error-log sweep, concluded a transient worker stall on one ingress pod; it self-healed, with a recurrence watch and restart plan left in place.
fix.cn: 扫了 90 分钟窗口的 error log 排除 memcached/Lua 超时假设，判定为单个 ingress pod 的瞬时 worker 卡顿；已自愈，留下复发监控和重启预案。

lesson.en: An outer gateway's upstream_response_time includes the entire downstream chain, not just the app; always decompose latency layer by layer before blaming the backend.
lesson.cn: 外层网关的 upstream_response_time 包含整条下游链路而不只是应用本身；下结论前必须逐层拆解延迟，不能直接甩锅后端。

title.en: ASG Scale-Out Nodes That Never Joined the Cluster
title.cn: ASG 扩容节点迟迟进不了集群

symptom.en: Auto Scaling Group scale-out instances either got terminated right after launch, or booted fine but never showed up as Ready Kubernetes nodes, blocking capacity recovery.
symptom.cn: ASG 扩容出来的实例要么刚启动就被终止，要么能开机但始终没有以 Ready 状态加入 Kubernetes 集群，容量一直恢复不了。

localization.en: Split the problem into two distinct stages with separate evidence paths: instance launch (ASG Activity history, EC2 status checks, Launch Template/AMI) versus cluster join (cloud-init results, journalctl -u kubelet, kubeadm join logs).
localization.cn: 把问题切成两个证据链完全不同的阶段：实例启动失败（ASG Activity、EC2 状态检查、Launch Template/AMI）和集群加入失败（cloud-init 结果、journalctl -u kubelet、kubeadm join 日志）。

fix.en: Rolled back to a known-good Launch Template/AMI to restore schedulable capacity first, then fixed the join path; user-data encoding mismatch (plaintext vs base64) is the classic pitfall here.
fix.cn: 先回滚到已知可用的 Launch Template/AMI 恢复可调度容量，再修加入链路；user-data 编码不匹配（明文 vs base64）是这里的经典坑。

lesson.en: Restore capacity before root-causing; "cannot launch" and "cannot join" are completely different failure paths and must be separated as the first triage decision.
lesson.cn: 先恢复容量再查根因；「起不来」和「加不进」是完全不同的失败路径，triage 第一步就要把两者分开。

title.en: Connection Refused: Eight Hops to Find Where Nobody Was Listening
title.cn: Connection refused：八跳链路上找出没人监听的那一环

symptom.en: External clients got connection refused on ClickHouse's exposed port while the pods themselves looked Running.
symptom.cn: 外部客户端连 ClickHouse 对外端口时报 connection refused，但 pod 本身看起来一切 Running。

localization.en: Walked Client, DNS, NLB, NodePort, ingress-nginx, Service, Endpoints, Process hop by hop; kubectl get endpoints returned <none>: after an abnormal pod restart the operator had left the readiness label at "no", so the Service selector matched zero pods.
localization.cn: 沿 Client、DNS、NLB、NodePort、ingress-nginx、Service、Endpoints、进程逐跳排查；kubectl get endpoints 返回 <none>：pod 异常重启后 operator 没有刷新 readiness label（停在 no），Service selector 匹配不到任何 pod。

fix.en: Rollout-restarted the ClickHouse StatefulSet so the operator re-evaluated and reset the ready label; endpoints repopulated and external connections succeeded again.
fix.cn: 对 ClickHouse StatefulSet 做 rollout restart，让 operator 重新评估并写回 ready label；endpoints 重新填充，外部连接恢复。

lesson.en: Refused means nothing is listening at some hop, so stop at the first failing hop; operator-managed label gating is a classic way for a Service to silently lose every endpoint.
lesson.cn: refused 意味着链路上某一跳没人监听，排查应停在第一个失败的跳上；operator 用 label 做 endpoints 门控，是 Service 悄悄失去全部后端的经典方式。

title.en: A Cross-Cluster Restore Marked Failed Too Early
title.cn: 被过早判死刑的跨集群数据恢复

symptom.en: The cross-cluster ClickHouse recovery workflow (EBS snapshot, PV/PVC swap, restart, validate) was marked failed by the data-copy service, putting a destructive rerun on the table.
symptom.cn: 跨集群 ClickHouse 恢复流程（EBS snapshot、PV/PVC 置换、重启、校验）被数据拷贝服务标记为失败，眼看要触发破坏性重跑。

localization.en: Status API timestamps plus logs showed every stage had completed; probing ClickHouse directly (TCP 9000 open, select 1 succeeds) proved the database had actually recovered, and the automation's pod-ready gate had simply validated before ClickHouse was truly up.
localization.cn: status API 时间戳加日志显示各阶段其实都已完成；直接探测 ClickHouse（TCP 9000 可连、select 1 成功）证明数据库已恢复，是自动化用 pod-ready 当就绪门槛，校验跑得太早误判失败。

fix.en: Avoided any destructive rollback or rerun; scaled back up and re-validated after true readiness, then changed the workflow's verification to wait for TCP 9000 plus a real SQL probe before declaring failure.
fix.cn: 没有执行任何破坏性回滚或重跑；扩容回来等真正就绪后重新校验，并把流程的失败判定改为必须等 TCP 9000 加真实 SQL 探测。

lesson.en: A control-plane "task failed" is not a data-plane fact; independently verify the database before acting on any recovery failure, especially when the next step is destructive.
lesson.cn: 控制面的「任务失败」不等于数据面的事实；对恢复类失败必须先独立验证数据库本身，尤其当下一步操作是破坏性的时候。

title.en: The Resource Bump That Could Not Be Scheduled
title.cn: 资源翻倍之后，Pod 卡死在 Pending

symptom.en: After raising ClickHouse resources from 2 CPU / 18Gi to 8 CPU / 64Gi, the pod stayed Pending; scheduler events showed Insufficient cpu/memory plus node affinity/selector mismatches.
symptom.cn: 把 ClickHouse 资源从 2 CPU / 18Gi 提到 8 CPU / 64Gi 之后 pod 一直 Pending；调度事件同时报 Insufficient cpu/memory 和 node affinity/selector 不匹配。

localization.en: The dedicated node group (r7i.2xlarge, nominally 8 vCPU / 64GB) only offered about 7.5 CPU / 60Gi allocatable, below the new requests; a larger r7i.4xlarge pool existed but lacked the dedicated-node label required by the strict nodeSelector, so it was never a candidate.
localization.cn: 专用节点组（r7i.2xlarge，标称 8 vCPU / 64GB）的 allocatable 只有约 7.5 CPU / 60Gi，低于新的 requests；集群里有更大的 r7i.4xlarge 池，但缺少 nodeSelector 要求的专用 label，根本不在候选之列。

fix.en: Created a new dedicated node group on r7i.4xlarge with the dedicated node label preserved in the bootstrap args; the pod scheduled and ran stably.
fix.cn: 新建了一个 r7i.4xlarge 的专用节点组，并在启动参数里保留原有的专用 label；pod 顺利调度并稳定运行。

lesson.en: The scheduler compares requests against allocatable, which is always below the instance spec, and a strict nodeSelector silently excludes otherwise-fit nodes; a resource bump must be coupled with a node group review.
lesson.cn: 调度器比较的是 requests 和 allocatable，后者永远小于实例标称规格；严格的 nodeSelector 会静默排除本来放得下的节点，加资源必须连带评审节点组。

title.en: 1.21 TiB of Zombie Tables Behind a One-Second OOM
title.cn: 1.21 TiB 僵尸表引爆的一秒 OOM

symptom.en: Kafka consumer lag alerts on velocity topics across multiple tenants; ClickHouse inserts were dying with Code 241 "memory limit exceeded: would use 21.60 GiB", and failed batches looped through a 30s sleep plus rebalance retry.
symptom.cn: 多个租户的 velocity topic 同时报 Kafka consumer lag；ClickHouse 写入被 Code 241「memory limit exceeded: would use 21.60 GiB」杀掉，失败批次陷入 30 秒 sleep 加 rebalance 的重试循环。

localization.en: system.metric_log's 1-second series showed memory jumping from a ~2 GiB baseline to 21.60 GiB within one second, invisible to 30s Prometheus scrapes; system.tables exposed upgrade-residue zombies, trace_log_2 at 1.21 TiB and processors_profile_log_0 at 308 GiB, whose background merges triggered the spike.
localization.cn: system.metric_log 的 1 秒粒度序列显示内存在一秒内从约 2 GiB 基线飙到 21.60 GiB，30 秒的 Prometheus 抓取完全看不见；system.tables 揪出升级残留的僵尸表，trace_log_2 高达 1.21 TiB、processors_profile_log_0 308 GiB，它们的后台 merge 正是尖峰来源。

fix.en: Truncated the active system logs, dropped every _N zombie table (bypassing the 50 GB drop guard), then added TTLs and disabled trace_log in config; a fleet-wide audit found a sibling cluster carrying another 1.65 TiB of the same debt.
fix.cn: TRUNCATE 活跃系统日志表，逐个 DROP 所有 _N 僵尸表（绕过 50 GB 删除保护），随后在配置里加 TTL 并禁用 trace_log；全 fleet 巡检又在兄弟集群发现 1.65 TiB 的同类欠账。

lesson.en: ClickHouse upgrades rename old system log tables instead of dropping them; the visible alert (Kafka lag) can be two hops downstream from the real cause, and sub-second memory spikes need 1s-granularity evidence, not scrape-interval dashboards.
lesson.cn: ClickHouse 升级只重命名旧系统日志表而不删除；看得见的告警（Kafka lag）可能离真凶隔着两跳，而亚秒级内存尖峰必须靠 1 秒粒度证据，抓取间隔级的看板抓不住。

title.en: 92% CPU: Merges Took the Blame, Full Scans Did the Damage
title.cn: 92% CPU：merge 背了锅，真凶是全表扫描

symptom.en: One ClickHouse container pinned at 27.6 of 30 cores (92%) with load average 75.64, while memory sat at 54% and restarts stayed at zero; every other cluster was under 20%.
symptom.cn: 单个 ClickHouse 容器 CPU 钉在 27.6/30 核（92%），load average 高达 75.64，内存只用 54% 且零重启；其他集群全部低于 20%。

localization.en: system.merges alone suggested merge debt, but pairing system.processes with top -H told the real split: 3 concurrent SELECT * full scans reading ~700M rows each consumed 20+ cores (~67%), while TTL/rewrite merges took only ~3 cores (~10%).
localization.cn: 只看 system.merges 会得出 merge 欠账的结论，但 system.processes 配合 top -H 给出真实占比：3 条并发 SELECT * 全表扫描各读约 7 亿行，吃掉 20+ 核（约 67%），TTL/重写 merge 只占约 3 核（约 10%）。

fix.en: Identified the client issuing the eventId lookup queries; short-term cap max_threads and replace SELECT * with needed columns, long-term add a projection or bloom-filter skip index so eventId lookups stop scanning 700M rows.
fix.cn: 定位到发起 eventId 查询的调用方；短期压低 max_threads 并把 SELECT * 改成按需列，长期给 eventId 加 projection 或 bloom filter skip index，让点查不再扫 7 亿行。

lesson.en: Never conclude a CPU root cause from system.merges alone; always run both system.processes and the top -H thread breakdown to separate query load from merge load before acting.
lesson.cn: 绝不能只凭 system.merges 给 CPU 定根因；必须同时跑 system.processes 和 top -H 线程分解，把查询负载和 merge 负载拆开再下结论。

title.en: One DDL Change, Three Cascading CDC Failures
title.cn: 一次 DDL 变更引发的 CDC 三连崩

symptom.en: After a release shrank a MySQL table from 4 columns to 2, the CDC connector crashed with "internal schema size 4, but row size 2"; post-restart, writes flooded with "Cannot set null to non-nullable column _sign Int8".
symptom.cn: 一次发布把 MySQL 表从 4 列改成 2 列后，CDC connector 以「internal schema size 4, but row size 2」崩溃；重启后写入端刷屏「Cannot set null to non-nullable column _sign Int8」。

localization.en: The crash forced a full snapshot in schema-recovery mode; snapshot events carry op_type=r, which the connector never mapped to a _sign value, so ClickHouse's NOT NULL column rejected 23 minutes of writes; a third failure hit the idle standby side, where a network middlebox killed the TCP connection after ~431s, far below MySQL's 8h wait_timeout.
localization.cn: 崩溃触发 schema recovery 模式下的全量 snapshot；snapshot 事件的 op_type 是 r，connector 从未为它映射 _sign 值，ClickHouse 的 NOT NULL 列拒收了 23 分钟的写入；第三个故障出在空闲的备用侧，网络中间层约 431 秒就掐断 TCP 连接，远小于 MySQL 8 小时的 wait_timeout。

fix.en: The connector self-recovered once the snapshot finished, with the 23-minute rejection window flagged for a data-gap check; prevention: default _sign=1 for snapshot events, plus 30s heartbeats and TCP keepalive to outlive the ~431s idle cutoff.
fix.cn: snapshot 完成后 connector 自动恢复，23 分钟被拒窗口列入补数核查；防复发措施：给 snapshot 事件配 _sign 默认值 1，并用 30 秒 heartbeat 加 TCP keepalive 扛过约 431 秒的空闲切断。

lesson.en: DDL changes must be coordinated with CDC connectors, and "connector recovered" never means the data is complete; a ~431s timeout signature points at network middleboxes, not the database.
lesson.cn: DDL 变更必须和 CDC connector 协同，「connector 恢复了」绝不等于数据完整；431 秒量级的超时特征指向网络中间层，而不是数据库本身。

title.en: Ingress Queueing Under a Single-Tenant QPS Spike
title.cn: 单租户 QPS 尖峰打爆 ingress 排队

symptom.en: Production serving API p95/p99 stayed high for over 10 minutes; ingress request_time was elevated while upstream_response_time held at baseline, and the traffic surge was dominated by one large tenant.
symptom.cn: 生产 serving API 的 p95/p99 持续高位超过 10 分钟；ingress request_time 升高但 upstream_response_time 稳在基线，流量激增由某大租户主导。

localization.en: Latency decomposition (request_time minus upstream_response_time) classified it as waiting_latency dominance, i.e. ingress connection/queue saturation rather than application slowness; per-tenant QPS confirmed single-tenant dominance and ingress saturation signals (connections, CPU, retries) all matched.
localization.cn: 用 request_time 减 upstream_response_time 做延迟分解，确认 waiting_latency 占主导，即 ingress 连接/队列饱和而非应用变慢；分租户 QPS 证实单租户主导，ingress 饱和信号（连接数、CPU、重试）全部吻合。

fix.en: Applied tenant-aware rate limiting/degradation and distributed traffic to cut the peak, then scaled ingress controller capacity; verified waiting_latency converged back toward upstream_response_time and p95/p99 held at baseline.
fix.cn: 对该租户做定向限流/降级并分流削峰，再扩 ingress controller 容量；验证 waiting_latency 重新贴近 upstream_response_time，p95/p99 稳定回基线。

lesson.en: Prove waiting_latency dominance before touching the application layer; tenant-dominant spikes need tenant-scoped mitigation, not blanket scaling.
lesson.cn: 动应用层之前先证明是 waiting_latency 主导；单租户主导的尖峰要用租户级手段处置，而不是无差别扩容。

title.en: One Empty caBundle Blocked Every Helm Install in the Cluster
title.cn: 一个空 caBundle 卡死全集群 helm install

symptom.en: Multiple tenants' Flink batch jobs failed within the same minute; every helm install carrying an Ingress resource died with "x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" from the ingress-nginx admission webhook.
symptom.cn: 多个租户的 Flink batch job 在同一分钟内批量失败；所有含 Ingress 资源的 helm install 都被 ingress-nginx admission webhook 以「x509: certificate signed by unknown authority」拒绝。

localization.en: Diffed the ValidatingWebhookConfiguration's caBundle against the CA in the admission Secret: a recent ingress-nginx helm upgrade had recreated the webhook config without patching the caBundle back, so the apiserver could not verify the webhook's TLS certificate.
localization.cn: 把 ValidatingWebhookConfiguration 的 caBundle 与 admission Secret 里的 CA 做 diff：近期一次 ingress-nginx helm upgrade 重建了 webhook 配置但没把 caBundle patch 回去，apiserver 因此无法验证 webhook 的 TLS 证书。

fix.en: Patched the CA from the Secret back into the webhook config with a single JSON patch and verified via a server-side dry-run ingress create; long-term, migrate webhook certificates from one-shot helm hooks to cert-manager with rotation.
fix.cn: 用一条 JSON patch 把 Secret 里的 CA 写回 webhook 配置，并用 server-side dry-run 创建 ingress 验证通过；长期方案是把 webhook 证书从一次性 helm hook 迁到可轮换的 cert-manager。

lesson.en: Many tenants failing through the same mechanism at the same time is a cluster-wide infrastructure signal, not an application bug; "recent helm upgrade plus webhook failure" should route straight to change-management triage.
lesson.cn: 多租户同时以同一机制失败，是 cluster 级基础设施信号而非应用 bug；「近期 helm upgrade 加 webhook 失败」应直接路由到变更管理类 triage。

title.en: Mass Evictions: Replace the Node Instead of Fighting Image GC
title.cn: 批量 Evicted：换节点，别跟镜像 GC 较劲

symptom.en: Large numbers of pods showed Evicted with "The node had condition: [DiskPressure]"; node events reported EvictionThresholdMet and ImageGCFailed with 0 bytes eligible to free.
symptom.cn: 大量 pod 变成 Evicted，消息带「The node had condition: [DiskPressure]」；节点事件报 EvictionThresholdMet，且 ImageGCFailed 显示可回收空间为 0 字节。

localization.en: Classified it as kubelet ephemeral-storage eviction rather than app crashes; node checks (df -h / df -i, containerd/kubelet/log directories) confirmed the node could not self-heal because image GC had nothing reclaimable, on a small ~50G root disk hosting large-image workloads.
localization.cn: 判定为 kubelet 的 ephemeral-storage 驱逐而非应用崩溃；节点级检查（df -h / df -i、containerd/kubelet/日志目录）确认镜像 GC 已无可回收内容，约 50G 的小根盘上还跑着多个大镜像负载，无法自愈。

fix.en: Cordoned and drained the node and let the ASG replace it with a clean instance; prevention: larger root volumes, ephemeral-storage requests/limits, log rotation, and alerts on DiskPressure/ImageGCFailed signals.
fix.cn: cordon 加 drain 后交给 ASG 换一台干净的新节点；预防措施包括加大根盘、为写盘负载设 ephemeral-storage requests/limits、日志轮转，以及对 DiskPressure/ImageGCFailed 建告警。

lesson.en: When ImageGCFailed keeps recurring on ASG-managed workers, node replacement beats repeated cleanup; also redact env vars before pasting kubectl describe output into tickets, since it can contain plaintext secrets.
lesson.cn: ASG 管理的 worker 反复出现 ImageGCFailed 时，换节点优于反复清理；另外 kubectl describe 输出可能含明文密钥，贴进 ticket 前必须脱敏。

title.en: The Liveness Probe That Kept Killing Healthy Kafka Brokers
title.cn: 反复杀掉健康 Kafka broker 的 liveness probe

symptom.en: Kafka KRaft brokers restarted in rotation with frequent controller re-elections; each restart lined up with "Liveness probe failed" events rather than OOMKilled or JVM crashes.
symptom.cn: Kafka KRaft broker 轮流重启，controller 频繁重新选举；每次重启都与「Liveness probe failed」事件对齐，而非 OOMKilled 或 JVM 崩溃。

localization.en: Ruled out self-crash signals first, then matched restart timestamps to probe failures; the combination of false kills plus controller role flapping identified an over-aggressive livenessProbe killing brokers that were slow but healthy.
localization.cn: 先排除自身崩溃信号，再把重启时间点和 probe 失败对齐；误杀加 controller 角色反复漂移，指向过于激进的 livenessProbe 在杀慢但健康的 broker。

fix.en: Made liveness conservative (failureThreshold 99, periodSeconds 50, initialDelay 50s) while keeping readiness sensitive for traffic shedding; restarts stopped climbing and the controller stayed stable through the 60-minute observation window.
fix.cn: 把 liveness 调保守（failureThreshold 99、periodSeconds 50、initialDelay 50s），readiness 保持灵敏用于摘流量；重启计数不再上涨，controller 在 60 分钟观察窗内保持稳定。

lesson.en: For quorum-based stateful systems, liveness probes must be forgiving: readiness sheds traffic but liveness kills, and confusing the two turns slowness into an outage.
lesson.cn: 对基于 quorum 的有状态系统，liveness probe 必须宽容：readiness 只摘流量而 liveness 会直接杀进程，两者混用会把「慢」放大成「挂」。

title.en: Kafka Lag That Was Really a ClickHouse Problem
title.cn: 看着是 Kafka lag，其实病在 ClickHouse

symptom.en: Consumer group lag ran high across multiple topics simultaneously; ClickHouse logs in the same window showed "Delaying inserting block by 10 ms because there are 1015 parts", climbing past 1058 parts.
symptom.cn: 一个 consumer group 在多个 topic 上同时报高 lag；同窗口的 ClickHouse 日志刷「Delaying inserting block by 10 ms because there are 1015 parts」，parts 数一路涨过 1058。

localization.en: Time-correlated the lag spike with ClickHouse insert backpressure; the consumer pods themselves had no OOM, restarts, or throttling, so classified it as a downstream sink bottleneck: a parts explosion throttling inserts and dragging consumer throughput down.
localization.cn: 把 lag 尖峰与 ClickHouse 写入 backpressure 做时间对齐；消费端 pod 本身无 OOM、无重启、无限流，判定为下游 sink 瓶颈：parts 爆炸导致写入被延迟，拖垮消费吞吐。

fix.en: Restarted the async consumer pods to unstick the pipeline and lag drained back to baseline; follow-ups on parts governance (merge/partition strategy, batch sizing) plus alerts on parts count and insert delay.
fix.cn: 重启异步消费服务的 pod 解开卡点，lag 回落到基线；后续跟进 parts 治理（merge/分区策略、batch 尺寸）并给 parts 数和写入延迟建告警。

lesson.en: Kafka lag is usually a symptom rather than the disease; the pairing of lag plus "Delaying inserting block" should be read as a downstream write bottleneck first, before tuning the consumer.
lesson.cn: Kafka lag 通常是症状而非病灶；lag 加「Delaying inserting block」这组信号应先按下游写入瓶颈处理，而不是先调消费者。

title.en: Three Partitions Against a Growing Tenant
title.cn: 3 个 partition 扛不住持续增长的大租户

symptom.en: Lag alerts fired on a large tenant's velocity topics; dashboards showed cross-cluster replication lag sitting high and draining only slowly, with no errors anywhere.
symptom.cn: 某大租户的 velocity 相关 topic 报 lag 告警；面板显示跨集群复制 lag 高位缓慢消化，全程无任何报错。

localization.en: First split consumer lag from MirrorMaker replication lag via the dedicated mirror-lag dashboard; MirrorMaker pods were healthy (no OOM or restarts), but the tenant's QPS had grown while the topic still had only 3 partitions, capping per-partition mirror throughput.
localization.cn: 先用 mirror lag 专用面板把消费者 lag 和 MirrorMaker 复制 lag 分开；MirrorMaker pod 资源健康（无 OOM 无重启），但该租户 QPS 上涨而 topic 只有 3 个 partition，单 partition 复制吞吐触顶。

fix.en: No restart needed short-term since lag converged after the traffic peak; long-term: expand topic partitions (irreversible, needs key-distribution and rebalance review), add a dedicated mirror-lag alert, and tie capacity reviews to tenant QPS growth.
fix.cn: 短期无需重启，波峰过后 lag 自然收敛；长期：扩 topic partition（不可逆，需评估 key 分布与 rebalance 影响）、给 mirror lag 配独立告警、把容量评审与租户 QPS 增长挂钩。

lesson.en: Partition count is a hard ceiling on replication throughput; distinguishing which lag it is, consumer versus mirror, is the mandatory first branch of any Kafka lag triage.
lesson.cn: partition 数是复制吞吐的硬天花板；分清到底是消费者 lag 还是 mirror lag，是所有 Kafka lag triage 的必答第一题。

title.en: Degrade First, Scale With Caps: Surviving a Large-Tenant Spike
title.cn: 先降级再限额扩容：扛住大租户流量洪峰

symptom.en: A single large tenant's QPS spike degraded the real-time serving path end to end: error rate and p95/p99 climbing, Kafka backlog building, and the database approaching saturation.
symptom.cn: 某大租户的 QPS 尖峰把实时 serving 链路整体拖垮：错误率与 p95/p99 上升，Kafka 积压增长，数据库逼近饱和。

localization.en: Traced the spike's entry path (client, traffic switch, gateway, serving) and confirmed the bottleneck spanned serving pods, async consumers, tenant-scoped Kafka topics, and the database at once, so no single-layer fix would hold.
localization.cn: 沿入口路径（客户端、流量切换层、网关、serving）追踪尖峰，确认瓶颈同时压在 serving、异步消费、租户专属 Kafka topic 和数据库上，单层修复兜不住。

fix.en: Split traffic 50/50 across paths, zeroed non-critical recompute/backfill rate limits via tenant config with no restart, scaled serving/async HPA within explicit caps (consumer thread pool 40 core / 80 max), doubled the tenant topics' Kafka partitions and temporarily doubled the DB instance size; then stepped the limits back up gradually (0 to 2 to 5 to 10).
fix.cn: 流量 50/50 分流；通过租户配置在线把非关键的 recompute/backfill 限速清零（无需重启）；在明确上限内扩 serving/异步 HPA（消费线程池 40 核心 / 80 上限）；把该租户 topic 的 Kafka partition 翻倍并临时把 DB 实例规格翻倍；稳定后按 0 到 2 到 5 到 10 逐级恢复限速。

lesson.en: Degrade before you scale: adding serving capacity while the database has no headroom pushes the incident over the edge, and every emergency knob needs an explicit cap plus a written rollback plan.
lesson.cn: 先降级再扩容：数据库没有余量时加 serving 容量只会把事故推下悬崖；每个应急旋钮都要有明确上限和成文的回滚方案。

title.en: The P99 Alert With No Slow Request Behind It
title.cn: 背后没有一条慢请求的 P99 告警

symptom.en: A latency alert fired on P99 and the graph looked convincing, but the error rate stayed completely flat in the same window.
symptom.cn: P99 延迟告警触发，曲线看起来煞有介事，但同窗口错误率完全没有抬头。

localization.en: Checked application logs and APM in the same time window first: zero real slow requests; comparing per-instance histogram buckets and scrape timestamps showed scrape misalignment plus bucket aggregation skew inflating the aggregated P99.
localization.cn: 先查同时间窗的应用日志与 APM：一条真实慢请求都没有；对比各实例的 histogram bucket 和抓取时间戳，发现抓取时间错位叠加 bucket 聚合偏差，把聚合后的 P99 抬高了。

fix.en: Closed it as a false alert with logs/APM evidence attached, then hardened the rule: added a for: duration, moved percentiles onto recording rules, and aligned scrape timing so the pattern would not re-fire.
fix.cn: 附上日志/APM 证据按误告警结案，随后加固规则：加 for: 持续时间、把分位数改用 recording rule、对齐抓取时间，杜绝同模式复发。

lesson.en: Before trusting any percentile, disprove it against logs/APM; aggregated histogram quantiles can lie when scrapes misalign across instances, and alert state belongs to the rule engine, not to Slack history.
lesson.cn: 相信任何分位数之前先用日志/APM 证伪；实例间抓取错位时聚合的 histogram 分位数会说谎，而告警状态以规则引擎为准，不以 Slack 消息记录为准。

title.en: MySQL Timeouts That Followed One Worker Node Around
title.cn: 跟着某个 worker 节点走的 MySQL 超时

symptom.en: Serving pods logged MySQL "connect timed out" while MySQL itself was perfectly healthy; the failures clustered on pods scheduled to one specific worker node.
symptom.cn: serving 服务的 pod 日志报 MySQL「connect timed out」，但 MySQL 自身完全健康；失败集中在调度到某个特定 worker 节点上的 pod。

localization.en: First separated timeout from refused/auth errors, verified Service/Endpoints and the actual destination (Service DNS versus a NodePort-style path), then compared DNS and TCP probes from failing versus healthy pods: only pods on the one node failed, indicating node-level DNS/egress breakage.
localization.cn: 先把 timeout 与 refused/认证类错误分开，核对 Service/Endpoints 和实际目标地址（Service DNS 还是 NodePort 类路径），再在故障 pod 与健康 pod 内对比 DNS 与 TCP 探测：只有那台节点上的 pod 失败，指向节点级 DNS/出网故障。

fix.en: Restarted the serving deployment so pods rescheduled off the suspect node and the timeouts stopped without touching MySQL at all; cordoned the node and handed it to the network owner for root cause.
fix.cn: 重启 serving deployment 让 pod 调度离开可疑节点，完全没动 MySQL 超时就消失；随后 cordon 该节点并移交网络负责人查根因。

lesson.en: When connection failures are concentrated on one node, treat it as node-level DNS/egress breakage: move the workload first to stop the bleeding, then chase the node.
lesson.cn: 连接失败集中在单节点时，按节点级 DNS/出网故障处理：先迁走负载止血，再回头追那台节点的根因。

title.en: Why P100 Landed on Exactly 1.00s Every Few Minutes
title.cn: P100 为什么每隔几分钟正好停在 1.00 秒

symptom.en: Ingress waiting-latency P100 spiked to exactly 1.00s every 5-10 minutes while P50-P95 stayed at 1-2ms and upstream_response_time never moved from ~20-30ms; the top client accounted for 47.5% of affected requests.
symptom.cn: ingress waiting latency 的 P100 每 5 到 10 分钟精准冲到 1.00 秒，P50 到 P95 稳在 1 至 2ms，upstream_response_time 始终在约 20 至 30ms；受影响请求中头部客户占 47.5%。

localization.en: Cross-correlated slow access-log entries with error-log lines on second plus client IP: the rate-limit Lua plugin's synchronous memcached call was timing out; memcached ran as a single replica with 10 threads, file descriptors jumping 24 to 54 at spike time, and the 1.00s ceiling was exactly the Lua read timeout (1000ms, connect timeout 50ms).
localization.cn: 按秒级时间戳加客户端 IP 把慢请求 access log 与 error log 交叉对齐：限流 Lua 插件对 memcached 的同步调用在超时；memcached 单副本仅 10 线程，尖峰时刻文件描述符从 24 跳到 54，而 1.00 秒的天花板正是 Lua 读超时常量（1000ms，连接超时 50ms）。

fix.en: Mitigation plan: scale memcached replicas and raise threads from 10 to 32+, lower the Lua read timeout to 100-200ms to bound worst-case waiting, add a memcached exporter for connection visibility, and retire the deprecated image.
fix.cn: 缓解方案：memcached 扩副本并把线程从 10 提到 32+，Lua 读超时降到 100 至 200ms 以封顶最坏等待，加 memcached exporter 补上连接数可见性，并替换已弃用的镜像。

lesson.en: A suspiciously exact latency plateau is a timeout constant, not randomness; hunting down which config owns that number leads straight to the root cause.
lesson.cn: 延迟精确卡在某个整数上不是巧合而是某个超时常量；追问「这个数字写在哪个配置里」就能直达根因。

title.en: The Deployment That Would Not Recover After a Disk Cleanup
title.cn: 磁盘清理之后再也起不来的部署

symptom.en: A QA/Dev deployment failed with pods in CrashLoopBackOff and dependencies unavailable, shortly after a disk cleanup/reclaim cycle had run in the environment.
symptom.cn: QA/Dev 环境的部署失败，pod 反复 CrashLoopBackOff、依赖不可用，时间点紧跟一轮磁盘清理/回收任务之后。

localization.en: Proved the cleanup window overlapped the failure first, then used events and logs to find the first broken dependency in the chain: the storage/DB layer, not the upper-layer services that were visibly failing.
localization.cn: 先证明清理窗口与故障窗口重叠，再顺着 events 和日志找链条上第一个断掉的依赖：是底层存储/数据库，而不是表面上在报错的上层服务。

fix.en: Restored the database dependency first, then rebuilt the upper-layer services (BI/analytics UI) in strict dependency order and verified readiness; filed follow-ups to add retention guardrails to the cleanup job.
fix.cn: 先恢复数据库依赖，再按依赖顺序重建上层服务（BI/分析 UI）并验证就绪；跟进给清理任务加保留策略护栏防复发。

lesson.en: Fix in dependency order from the bottom up; the loudest failing component is rarely the first one that broke.
lesson.cn: 按依赖顺序自底向上修复；叫得最响的组件，往往不是最先坏掉的那个。

title.en: Spark Jobs That Never Reached Running
title.cn: 永远到不了 Running 的 Spark 任务

symptom.en: Spark/Luigi jobs sat in Pending, Init, or Terminating without ever reaching Running, holding cluster resources hostage and blocking the next scheduled runs.
symptom.cn: Spark/Luigi 任务卡在 Pending、Init 或 Terminating，始终到不了 Running，占着集群资源并堵住后续排程。

localization.en: Extracted the job_id from the alert (often the namespace suffix), confirmed the stuck pods in Kubernetes, then judged blast radius: one or two stuck jobs versus broadly unhealthy scheduling, which decides whether the worker pool itself needs recycling.
localization.cn: 从告警里提取 job_id（通常是 namespace 后缀），在 Kubernetes 里确认卡住的 pod，再判断爆炸半径：是个别任务卡住，还是调度整体不健康，这决定要不要动 worker 池。

fix.en: Terminated the stuck jobs through the cluster-manager API to release resources; when scheduling was broadly unhealthy, recycled the shared worker pool (scale to 0 then back to 50 replicas), but only after confirming no healthy jobs were in flight, and verified cleanup after every step.
fix.cn: 通过集群管理 API 终止卡住的任务释放资源；调度整体不健康时再回收共享 worker 池（缩到 0 再扩回 50 副本），且必须先确认没有健康任务在跑，每一步操作后都做清理验证。

lesson.en: Verify after every mutating step, and never recycle a shared worker pool without first proving nothing healthy is running in it.
lesson.cn: 每个写操作之后必须验证；没有先证明池里没有健康任务在跑，绝不回收共享 worker 池。

title.en: 285 Restarts and an Empty kubectl logs
title.cn: 285 次重启，kubectl logs 却一片空白

symptom.en: Another OLAP engine's frontend StatefulSet pod racked up 285 restarts in CrashLoopBackOff with exit code 143, while kubectl logs returned nothing at all.
symptom.cn: 另一款 OLAP 引擎的 frontend StatefulSet pod 累计重启 285 次，CrashLoopBackOff，退出码 143，而 kubectl logs 输出完全为空。

localization.en: Exec'd into the container to read the file-only frontend log: BerkeleyDB metadata persisted on the PVC had recorded the old pod IP; after restart the pod got a new IP, so the node stayed in UNKNOWN role, never opened port 9030, and the liveness probe killed it every 60 seconds in a loop.
localization.cn: exec 进容器读只写文件的 frontend 日志：PVC 上持久化的 BerkeleyDB 元数据记着旧 pod IP，重启后 pod 拿到新 IP，节点角色停在 UNKNOWN，9030 端口始终不开，liveness probe 每 60 秒杀一次，循环往复。

fix.en: Short-term: scale down, delete the PVC to wipe the stale metadata, scale up to reinitialize; permanent: switch to a headless Service plus FQDN host type so metadata records stable DNS names instead of ephemeral pod IPs.
fix.cn: 短期：缩容、删 PVC 清掉过期元数据、再扩容重新初始化；永久：改用 headless Service 并以 FQDN 作为节点标识，让元数据记录稳定的 DNS 名而非易变的 pod IP。

lesson.en: An empty kubectl logs does not mean no logs exist, some engines only write to files inside the container; and registering cluster members by IP inside Kubernetes is a design bug, because pod IPs are ephemeral.
lesson.cn: kubectl logs 为空不代表没有日志，有些引擎只往容器内文件写；而在 Kubernetes 里用 IP 注册集群成员本身就是设计缺陷，因为 pod IP 天生易变。
